description: This script converts JSON files into C header files with macro definitions and optionally dumps JSON objects as string constants. It includes command-line argument parsing, JSON processing, and code generation functions.

methods.name: process_cmd_line
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input/output files and processing options.

methods.name: json_load
methods.description: Loads JSON data from a specified file.

methods.name: json_to_header_body
methods.description: Converts JSON object into C macro definitions, handling nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: json_to_header_body_dump
methods.description: Generates C string constants with JSON object dumps for specified keys.
